label: Bible Study
prompt: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a _____ that breaketh the rock in pieces?
verse: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
note: God's word as fire and hammer — no gentle suggestion here.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all _____ from their eyes.
verse: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
note: The Lamb becomes the Shepherd, leading to living waters and wiping away all tears.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an _____.
verse: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
note: Proof the risen Jesus wasn't a spirit: he ate broiled fish in front of them — and the KJV adds a honeycomb.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his _____.
verse: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
note: Jeremiah admits human beings can't steer their own lives — then asks God to correct him gently.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Use hospitality one to another without _____.
verse: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
note: 'Use hospitality one to another without grudging' — open the door, and keep the complaints to yourself.
